mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market strengthening, boosting growth expectations and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both supply-side index (INDPRO) and demand-side GDP (GDPC1) signal robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) when both INDPRO and GDPC1 are rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in demand for goods (HOUST) during a late-cycle demand peak triggers a correction in equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns observed despite HOUST decline in late-cycle demand peak regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals pre-peak tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: No negative returns when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in the supply-side index (INDPRO) reflects increased production capacity, lowering inflation expectations and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) over 60 days when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions marked by rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) create a virtuous cycle of growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No positive 5-day returns when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in demand-side GDP (GDPC1) during a late-cycle expansion period signals resilient economic activity, lifting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) over 60 days when GDPC1 rises in late-cycle expansion.
